description: Source code for Vibrator HAL wrapper implementations, including classes for different HAL versions, handling external files, methods, and capabilities related to Android's vibrator hardware abstraction layer.

classes.name: HalResult
classes.description: Template class representing the result of HAL operations, encapsulating success, failure, or unsupported states.

classes.name: HalWrapper
classes.description: Base class providing common functionality for vibrator HAL wrappers, including caching capabilities and effect info.

classes.name: AidlHalWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class for AIDL-based vibrator HAL, managing connection, capabilities, and effect execution.

classes.name: HidlHalWrapper
classes.description: Template class for HIDL-based vibrator HAL, managing connection, version-specific perform methods, and capabilities.

methods.name: isStaticCastValid
methods.description: Checks if a static cast of an Effect enum to a specific type is valid within the enum range.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Retrieves cached or internal info about the vibrator capabilities and effects.

methods.name: performComposedEffect
methods.description: Performs a composed effect sequence; unsupported in this implementation.

methods.name: performPwleEffect
methods.description: Performs a Primitive Waveform Loop Effect; unsupported in this implementation.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the capabilities of the vibrator HAL, with caching.

methods.name: getPrimitiveDurations
methods.description: Returns durations for supported primitives, with caching.

methods.name: getSupportedEffectsInternal
methods.description: Retrieves supported effects from HAL; unsupported in this implementation.

methods.name: getSupportedBrakingInternal
methods.description: Retrieves supported braking effects; unsupported.

methods.name: getSupportedPrimitivesInternal
methods.description: Retrieves supported primitives; unsupported.

methods.name: getPrimitiveDurationsInternal
methods.description: Retrieves primitive durations; unsupported.

methods.name: getPrimitiveDelayMaxInternal
methods.description: Retrieves maximum delay for primitives; unsupported.

methods.name: getPrimitiveDurationMaxInternal
methods.description: Retrieves maximum primitive duration; unsupported.

methods.name: getCompositionSizeMaxInternal
methods.description: Retrieves maximum composition size; unsupported.

methods.name: getPwleSizeMaxInternal
methods.description: Retrieves maximum PWLE size; unsupported.

methods.name: getMinFrequencyInternal
methods.description: Retrieves minimum frequency; unsupported.

methods.name: getResonantFrequencyInternal
methods.description: Retrieves resonant frequency; unsupported.

methods.name: getFrequencyResolutionInternal
methods.description: Retrieves frequency resolution; unsupported.

methods.name: getQFactorInternal
methods.description: Retrieves Q factor; unsupported.

methods.name: getMaxAmplitudesInternal
methods.description: Retrieves maximum amplitudes; unsupported.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Pings the HAL to check connectivity.

methods.name: tryReconnect
methods.description: Attempts to reconnect to the HAL service.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Turns on the vibrator with a specified timeout, scheduling callback if supported.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Turns off the vibrator.

methods.name: setAmplitude
methods.description: Sets the amplitude of the vibrator.

methods.name: setExternalControl
methods.description: Configures external control; unsupported in this implementation.

methods.name: alwaysOnEnable
methods.description: Enables always-on effect; unsupported.

methods.name: alwaysOnDisable
methods.description: Disables always-on effect; unsupported.

methods.name: performEffect
methods.description: Performs a specific effect with optional callback scheduling.

methods.name: performComposedEffect
methods.description: Performs a sequence of effects; unsupported.

methods.name: performPwleEffect
methods.description: Performs a Primitive Waveform Loop Effect; unsupported.

methods.name: getCapabilitiesInternal
methods.description: Retrieves internal capabilities from HAL.
